description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rajanganaya Yaya 01, Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110177
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, dealing specifically with land ownership, possession interests, cadastral maps, and title determination processes across multiple districts.
